electric-lime.$description: Electric Lime — Primary action background, hero surface fills, accent panels — the singular chromatic charge against an otherwise achromatic system, creating brand presence through contrast not decoration

off-black-ink.$description: Off-Black Ink — Body text, headings, icon fills, link borders, button text — warm-tinted near-black that feels less clinical than pure black against parchment

off-white-canvas.$description: Off-White Canvas — Card surfaces, secondary page background — warm parchment replacing cold white as the resting surface for the lime accent

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Highest surface level, card fills, input fields — used where clean white needs to lift above the parchment

ash.$description: Ash — Borders, dividers, subtle structural lines, inactive backgrounds — the warm gray that separates surfaces without harshness

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted body text, secondary copy, card text — warm gray for de-emphasized information

deep-charcoal.$description: Deep Charcoal — Dark card surfaces, inverted blocks — for rare moments when the page flips to a dark island

stone.$description: Stone — Faint borders, decorative strokes — only visible at fine stroke widths

smoke.$description: Smoke — Placeholder backgrounds, subtle wash zones

otsono.$description: Single-family system covering everything from 90px display headlines (weight 500, line-height 0.89, tracking -0.03em) through 16px body (weight 400, line-height 1.5) to 10px micro-labels. Weight 500 is the emphasis voice used on headings, labels, and CTAs; weight 400 handles body, icons, and supporting text. The 0.1em tracking on small caps is reserved for eyebrow labels and category tags.
